title: Story premise ENT034: The Button Garden Expedition
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (miniature adventure). Hook: Every island has holes. One is a home. Takeaway/theme: A feature that looks like a gap can become the useful place.
description: A thimble-sized gardener needs to plant one bright seed in a neglected button box, but the smooth button surfaces offer nowhere to root. They discover a thread-filled buttonhole, nest the seed in it, and grow a fictional thread-flower that ties the scattered buttons into a garden path.
